title: Syed Badesha hussain
body:
Husaina Husaina
Jab Chali deen ki aur uske madadgaar ki baat
Ashiqe rabb ki, Muhammad ke wafadar ki baat
Sabr ki pyas ki, Isaar ki kirdar ki baat
Phir to hona hai, phir to hona hai mere syed-o-sardar ki baat
Haaan Dil me dhadakta hai- Sayed Badshah mera
Lab pe bhi rehta hai- Sayed Badshah mera
Mera Wazifa hai- Sayed Badshah mera
Aqaa mera
Maula mera Syed Badshah Hussain
<<MINI>>
Badshah Husain
Sayed Badshah Husain x8
Hum bhi Azaadar hai, Haa wafadar hai
Tere ghamkwar hai Sayed Badshah Husain
(Jaan Husain Jaane jaa jaan Husain
Dil o imaan Husain, haa mera sayed badshah Husain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ha Dil me rahe Maula mera
Yaad rahe karbobla
Jari rahe zikr sada
Sath rahe farshe aza
<<DIVIDER>>

Sab Azadaar kaho

aise sajaa deen e khuda

Jan e jaan jaane jaan karbala
Jane e jaan jaane jaan karbala
Hussain,,,,Hussain…Hussain…… Hussain,,,,Hussain…Hussaina…… Azadaaroo x3
Hum log Azadaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Seekhi hai wafa dar e shah e wafa se
Karte hai bohot pyar shahe karbobala se
Hote hi nahi dure kabhi farshe azaa se
Ay Azadaaro x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay sheh ke azadaro iss ghum ko manana hai
Ye farshe azadari ghar ghar me bichana hai
Shabbir ki ghurbat ka nauha bhi sunana hai Kyu karte hai ye matam duniya ko batana hai
Haaye kya kya na sitam mere maula ne uthaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nana se kiya wada sayed ne nibhaya hai
Ek din me bhare ghar ko sehra me lutaya hai
Ghum naujawan Akber ka- wawaila Husain Husain x4
